name: enableBold
description: Bold, with its `Mod+B` binding.

name: enableItalic
description: Italic, with its `Mod+I` binding.

name: enableUnderline
description: Underline, with its `Mod+U` binding.

name: enableStrike
description: Strikethrough.

name: enableCode
description: Inline code, as a mark rather than a block.

name: enableSubSup
description: Subscript and superscript, which are mutually exclusive.

name: enableClearFormatting
description: The "clear formatting" command.

name: enableHeadings
description: Headings at the levels given by `headingLevels`.

name: enableLists
description: Bulleted and numbered lists, with nesting.

name: enableCheckList
description: Checklists, which need `enableLists` as well.

name: enableBlockquote
description: Blockquotes.

name: enableCodeBlock
description: Fenced code blocks with syntax highlighting.

name: enableHorizontalRule
description: Horizontal rules.

name: enableLinks
description: Links, the link popover and URL validation.

name: enableImages
description: Images, including upload, drag-and-drop and paste.

name: enableTables
description: Tables and their editing controls.

name: enableEmoji
description: The emoji picker and its `:` trigger.

name: enableMentions
description: Mentions and their `@` trigger, configured through `mentions`.

name: enableMergeTags
description: Merge tags as atomic nodes, configured through `mergeTags` (fixes R23).

name: enableColor
description: Text colour, with the palette from `colors`.

name: enableBackgroundColor
description: Background colour, with the same palette.

name: enableFontFamily
description: The font-family dropdown, populated from `fontFamilies`.

name: enableFontSize
description: The font-size dropdown, populated from `fontSizes`.

name: enableAlign
description: Block alignment, with `left` as the canonical default (fixes R6).

name: enableIndent
description: Block indent and outdent.

name: enableHistory
description: Undo and redo, with their bindings and toolbar controls.

name: enableMarkdownShortcuts
description: Markdown input rules, such as `# ` for a heading.

name: enableFindReplace
description: The find-and-replace panel.

name: enableSourceView
description: The HTML source view, which sanitizes on apply.

name: enableFullscreen
description: The fullscreen toggle.

name: enableWordCount
description: Word counting, which `countUnit: 'words'` needs.

name: toolbarPosition
description: Which side of the content the toolbar sits on.

name: toolbarOverflow
description: What happens to items that do not fit at this width.

name: readOnlyToolbar
description: Hide or disable the toolbar in `readOnly` mode.

name: sanitizeOutput
description: Sanitize again on the way out, so a bug upstream cannot leak.

name: pastePrompt
description: Offer "Keep / Remove formatting" after a rich office paste.

name: autoLinkOnPaste
description: Turn pasted URLs into links.

name: autoLink
description: Turn typed URLs and e-mail addresses into links.

name: defaultProtocol
description: Protocol given to a bare host, in the popover and in autolinking.

name: allowDataUrlImages
description: Allow `data:` image sources, which bloat stored content.

name: maxLength
description: Counts text in `countUnit`, never markup (fixes R3).

name: maxLengthBehaviour
description: Whether the limit refuses further input or only warns.

name: required
description: Drives `aria-required` and the `isEmpty` check (fixes R2).

name: disabled
description: Not focusable, dimmed, `aria-disabled`. What forms should use.

name: readOnly
description: Selection and copy still work; editing does not.

name: autoGrow
description: Grow with the content rather than scrolling immediately.

name: fullscreen
description: Controlled fullscreen.

name: defaultFullscreen
description: Start in fullscreen, for an uncontrolled editor.

name: uploadAccept
description: Accepted file types, enforced before the upload starts.

name: maxUploadSize
description: Size ceiling, enforced before the file leaves the browser.

name: spellCheck
description: Browser spell-checking inside the content element.

name: dir
description: Writing direction; `rtl` mirrors the whole field, including the toolbar.

name: lang
description: The content language, for spell-checking and screen-reader pronunciation.

name: tabIndex
description: Tab order of the content element.

name: hideLabel
description: Visually hidden but still announced.

name: escapeExitsEditor
description: Let Escape move focus out of the editor.

name: contentClassName
description: Applied to `.rte-content`, for prose overrides.

name: unstyled
description: Structure and prose styles only, no chrome visuals.

name: className
description: Applied to the root element.

name: id
description: Base for the generated element ids; one is derived when absent (fixes R4).

name: changeDebounceMs
description: How long the typing has to stop before `onChangeDebounced` runs.
